jobs.title: Penetration Tester
jobs.description: Requires 3+ years of experience. 3+ years of experience in Cyber Security projects or penetration testing within a team environment Deep understanding of Entra ID (Azure AD), ARM, and RBAC models; identify attack paths involving Managed Identities, Service Principals, and Graph API abuse Knowledge of AWS and GCP IAM, including privilege escalation and cross-account access attacks
